title: Notify an Approval Assets Valuation Companies in Securities Activities
text:
(Unofficial Translation)
(Unofficial Translation)1
LAO PEOPLE’S DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC
PEACE INDEPENDENCE DEMOCRACY UNITY PROSPERITY
-----===000===-----
Lao Securities Commission
Lao Securities Commission Office No. 0064/LSCO
Vientiane Capital, dated: 18 Oct 2019
Notification
To: Persons, Juristic Persons and Organizations in Nationwide.
Re: Notify an Approval Assets Valuation Companies in Securities Activities.
− Pursuant to the Decision on Organization and Operations of Lao Securities
Commission Office No. 013/LSC, dated 17 December 2013;
− Pursuant to the Regulation on Approval Assets Valuation Companies, No. 003/LSC,
dated 8 December 2015.
The Lao Securities Commission Office notifies to persons, juristic persons and
organizations in Nationwide that heretofore the Lao Securities Commission Office has been
issued the approval certificates to 9 companies that can operate asset valuation services in
securities activities in compliance with the Law and related regulations as follows:
1. Sims Property Consultants Co., LTD, Telephone: +662 5304333;
2. Grant Sherman Appraisal (Lao) Co., LTD, Telephone: 030 5080163 and 020 97799508;
3. Lao Assets Appraisal Co., LTD, Telephone: 030 5080163;
4. Lao International Assets Appraisal Co., LTD, Telephone: 020 55716119 and 13
888558008;
5. Asia Lotus Valuation Co., LTD, Telephone: 020 55569999 and 021 351859;
1 Although every effort has been made to convey the meaning and effect of each provision of the original Lao
language version as accurately as possible, this English translation does not carry any legal authority. Only the
original Lao text has legal force; this English translation is strictly for reference.

(Unofficial Translation)
6. Lao Value Property Valuation Sole Co., LTD, Telephone: 020 54542169 and 13
808706976;
7. Lao Zhengxin Assets Appraisal Co., LTD, Telephone: 020 22229744;
8. Rich Appraisal Co., LTD, Telephone: +6662 5156090;
9. KK Lao Appraisal Co., LTD, Telephone: 020 55655753 and 030 9687858.
This notification replaces the notification on Approval Asset Valuation Companies in
Securities Activities No. 0041/LSCO, dated 19 July 2019.
If the Lao Securities Commission Office issued a certificate to other companies can
operate asset valuation services in securities activities shall additional notices in case by case.
Therefore, this is to be informed and implemented this notification.
Secretary General of the Lao Securities Commission Office
(Signed and sealed)
Saysamone CHANTHACHACK
